div.head: Ine 10
div.ab: Gif hwa reaflac ⁊ nydnæme binnan þam gemærum ures rices gedó, agife he ðone reaflac ⁊ gesylle LX scll' to wite.
LIIII. Gif hwa binnan þam gemærum ures rices reaflác ⁊ niednæme dó, agife he ðone reaflac ⁊ geselle LX scill. to wite.
Si quis intra commarciones (fines) regni nostri robariam et uiolentam captionem faciat, reddat ipsam robariam (et persoluat) et emendet LX sol. pro wita.
{LIIII} Gif hwa binnan þam gemærum ures rices reaflác ⁊ niednæme dó, agife he ðone reaflac ⁊ geselle LX sciƚƚ to wite.
If someone within the boundaries of our kingdom commits robbery and forceful plunder, let him return the plunder and give 60 shillings as a fine.
If anyone within the borders of our kingdom commits an act of robbery or seizes anything with violence, he shall restore the plunder and pay a fine of 60 shillings.
If anyone within the boundaries of our kingdom commit robbery and rapine, he is to give back the plunder and give 60 shillings as a fine.
Wenn jemand innerhalb der Grenzen unseres Reiches Raub und gewaltsame Wegnahme verübt, gebe er den Raub zurück und zahle [dem König] 60 Schill. zur Strafe.
If someone commits robbery and forcible seizure within the borders of our kingdom, let him give back the plunder and pay [the king] 60 shillings as a fine.
